import pandas as pd

# Load data
cpg = pd.read_csv("/workspace/JD_AgeRelated_CpG_noMT_Final.csv")

import pandas as pd

# Load data
cpg = pd.read_csv("/workspace/JD_AgeRelated_CpG_noMT_Final.csv")
chr_len = pd.read_csv("/workspace/JD_Chromosome_Length.csv")

print("CpG data shape:", cpg.shape)
print("CpG columns:", cpg.columns.tolist())
print()

filtered = cpg[(cpg["MethylationPercentage"] > 90) | (cpg["MethylationPercentage"] < 10)]
print("Filtered rows (>90% or <10% methylation):", filtered.shape[0])

# Unique filtered CpG positions per chromosome
unique_filtered = filtered.drop_duplicates(subset=["Pos"])
print("Unique filtered CpG positions:", unique_filtered.shape[0])

print("\nUnique CpGs per chromosome:")
per_chr = unique_filtered.groupby("Chromosome").size().reset_index(name="unique_cpgs")
print(per_chr.to_string())

# Merge with chromosome lengths (exclude MT)
chr_len_noMT = chr_len[chr_len["Chromosome"] != "MT"].copy()
# Convert Chromosome to match dtype
chr_len_noMT["Chromosome"] = chr_len_noMT["Chromosome"].astype(str)
per_chr["Chromosome"] = per_chr["Chromosome"].astype(str)

merged = chr_len_noMT.merge(per_chr, on="Chromosome", how="left")
merged["unique_cpgs"] = merged["unique_cpgs"].fillna(0)
merged["density"] = merged["unique_cpgs"] / merged["Length"]

print("\nPer-chromosome density:")
print(merged[["Chromosome", "Length", "unique_cpgs", "density"]].to_string())

# Genome-wide average chromosomal density = mean of per-chromosome densities
avg_density = merged["density"].mean()
print(f"\nGenome-wide average chromosomal density: {avg_density:.6e}")

# Also compute the weighted (overall) density for comparison
total_cpgs = merged["unique_cpgs"].sum()
total_length = merged["Length"].sum()
weighted_density = total_cpgs / total_length
print(f"Weighted (total) density: {weighted_density:.6e}")
